meta.title: Delivery loop
meta.description: Run resumable end-to-end delivery inside DeepSeek Harness: a task graph, isolated workers, verification, independent review, and acceptance. Open the Delivery Loop strip under a session composer, or Settings → Delivery loop to browse every run. The view shows live progress, each decision, task details, changed-file previews, artifacts, and events. Run data stays in the target repository's .delivery/ directory.
